questions.prompt: An electron beam has a very short wavelength, but the microscope does not resolve details as small as that wavelength. Which explanations are correct?

options.text: A short wavelength is helpful, but lens aberrations can restrict the usable numerical aperture.
The measured resolution must equal the wavelength once the display magnification is sufficiently high.
A larger usable convergence angle can reduce diffraction-related probe broadening.
Increasing electron kinetic energy lengthens the electron wavelength.

questions.explanation:
A 对：电子透镜像差可限制实际能使用的会聚角，短波长本身不是充分条件。B 错：显示放大不能恢复没有分辨出的细节。C 对：可用会聚角增大，可减轻衍射造成的展宽。D 错：提高电子动能会缩短而非加长波长，但实际分辨率还受电子光学条件限制。

重点词：wavelength（波长）；usable aperture（可用孔径）；resolution（分辨能力）
逻辑链：短波长提供潜力 → 像差限制可用会聚角并展宽探针 → 实际分辨能力不能只看波长。

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly explain how an electron lens focuses and magnifies?

options.text: An electron lens can focus a beam and change image magnification; magnification is not itself a guarantee of finer resolution.
A glass lens can replace a magnetic electron lens because fast electrons pass through glass like visible light.
The strength of a magnetic lens is fixed at manufacture and cannot be changed electrically.
Magnetic fields deflect fast electrons, and changing the coil current changes lens strength.

questions.explanation:
A 对：聚焦和放大的基本概念也适用于电子透镜，但把图像变大不等于获得更多真实细节。B 错：玻璃会阻挡、散射电子，不是电子透镜的透明材料。C 错：磁透镜的线圈电流可调，聚焦强度并非制造后固定。D 对：磁场改变电子轨迹，线圈电流使聚焦条件可调。

重点词：magnetic lens（磁透镜）；coil current（线圈电流）；magnification（放大倍数）
逻辑链：调节线圈电流 → 磁场及电子轨迹改变 → 聚焦与放大可调，但显示放大不等于真实分辨改善。

questions.prompt: Changing focus reverses an image elongation between two perpendicular directions. Which interpretations and actions are appropriate?

options.text: This is the expected signature of axial coma, so beam tilt alone is the required correction.
The lens can have different focal lengths in perpendicular directions.
A quadrupole stigmator can reshape an oval electron beam towards a circular beam.
Changing only the acceleration voltage guarantees removal of the elongation.

questions.explanation:
A 错：随欠焦/过焦转向的垂直拉伸是像散，不是边缘彗星状拖尾的彗差。B 对：不同方向焦距不同解释这种焦点相关变形。C 对：四极像散校正器通过定向磁场重塑束形。D 错：改束能不代替像散校正；仍应先识别像差并调stigmator。

重点词：astigmatism（像散）；underfocus/overfocus（欠焦/过焦）；stigmator（像散校正器）
逻辑链：不同方向焦距不一致 → 调焦时拉伸方向改变 → 调节stigmator以修正束形。

questions.prompt: Which statements distinguish axial coma from chromatic aberration?

options.text: Comet-like tails near the image edge can be reduced by aligning the beam more parallel to the optical axis.
Chromatic aberration arises because electrons with different energies are not focused in exactly the same way.
The relatively narrow electron-energy distribution discussed in the lecture reduces the importance of chromatic aberration.
Making the beam monochromatic also necessarily removes spherical aberration.

questions.explanation:
A 对：彗星状拖尾对应轴向彗差，束倾斜对准有助于减轻。B 对：色差是不同能量对应不同聚焦条件；光学镜片的彩边是同类概念的类比。C 对：较窄的电子能量分布可减轻色差影响。D 错：单色性不等于无球差，球差还取决于电子离光轴的远近。

重点词：axial coma（轴向彗差）；chromatic aberration（色差）；energy spread（能量分布宽度）
逻辑链：先按现象区分来源 → 彗差检查束倾斜，色差检查能量分布 → 选择对应校正方法。

questions.prompt: A round electron lens gives a blurred probe even when all electrons have nearly the same energy. Which explanations are justified?

options.text: The outer rays can be focused more strongly than near-axis rays.
Spherical aberration is caused only by energy spread, so the stated observation is impossible.
Optical systems can use aspherical or suitable convex–concave glass elements, while the ordinary round electron lenses discussed act as simple convex lenses.
An ordinary circular aperture reshapes the electron beam in exactly the same way as a multipole corrector.

questions.explanation:
A 对：课件球差示意中远轴射线焦点更靠近透镜，造成探针展宽。B 错：把色差和球差混淆。C 对：这是光学与普通圆形磁透镜在球差控制方面的差别。D 错：限孔靠挡去严重离焦的外侧电子；多极校正靠磁场重塑束形，两者机制不同。

重点词：spherical aberration（球差）；off-axis rays（远轴射线）；aspherical lens（非球面透镜）
逻辑链：远轴与近轴电子聚焦不同 → 束斑模糊 → 需控制径向聚焦差异，而非只改善单色性。

questions.prompt: An uncorrected STEM gives broad probes with both very small and very large apertures. Which conclusions follow?

options.text: The smallest aperture must give the narrowest probe because it removes every wave effect.
Small apertures reduce high-angle spherical-aberration contributions but increase diffraction broadening and discard electrons.
Large apertures can admit strongly aberrated outer rays; a medium aperture can minimize the total broadening.
Choosing the aperture requires a compromise between probe broadening and the available beam current.

questions.explanation:
A 错：电子始终有波动性，小孔反而增加衍射。B 对：小孔挡掉高角度电子，可减少球差贡献，同时损失束流并加强衍射展宽。C 对：大孔会放入较强像差的外侧电子，中等孔径可使总展宽较小。D 对：不能只追求一个指标，既要考虑细节分辨，也要考虑有多少电子提供信号。

重点词：aperture（孔径）；diffraction broadening（衍射展宽）；beam current（束流）
逻辑链：缩小孔径 → 外侧球差贡献下降，但衍射增强且电子减少 → 在分辨与信号之间找合理折中。

questions.prompt: Which descriptions of STEM image acquisition are correct?

options.text: A focused probe is raster-scanned; the detected signal at each position contributes an image pixel.
BF and ADF signals cannot be recorded from the same scan because only one transmitted electron signal exists.
A BF detector accepts central transmitted electrons, including the direct beam and low-angle scattering in the illustrated geometry.
An ADF detector is an X-ray detector placed above the specimen.

questions.explanation:
A 对：STEM与SEM一样逐点扫描形成像素。B 错：BF与ADF接受透射束中不同角度部分，可同步采集；课件MgO/Au例子就是同区互补图。C 对：BF接受中心直透及小角散射。D 错：ADF是样品下方环形电子探测器，不是上方X射线检测。

重点词：raster scan（光栅扫描）；bright field（明场）；annular dark field（环形暗场）
逻辑链：逐点扫描 → 探测器按散射角接收不同电子 → 同一区域可同时形成互补图像。

questions.prompt: Which statements about annular dark-field detector selection are supported?

options.text: HAADF, MAADF and LAADF select high-, medium- and low-angle ranges of transmitted scattered electrons.
LAADF can be useful for light elements because these scatter electrons relatively weakly.
A bright atom must have the same brightness ordering in BF, LAADF and HAADF regardless of specimen structure.
Changing the accepted scattering angles is equivalent to measuring an EDS spectrum at each pixel.

questions.explanation:
A 对：三种ADF模式按接受角度范围命名。B 对：课件指出轻元素散射较弱，低角接收可能有利。C 错：模式、接受角和结构都会影响对比，不能使用跨模式的通用亮度规则。D 错：角度选择仍是电子强度成像；EDS谱是特征X射线的能量分布。

重点词：scattering angle（散射角）；HAADF（高角环形暗场）；LAADF（低角环形暗场）
逻辑链：元素与结构影响散射 → 接受角度决定收集哪部分信号 → 对比需要结合模式解释。

questions.prompt: During STEM alignment, a Ronchigram can be used because

options.text: It is necessarily a sharp Bragg-spot pattern from a perfect single crystal.
A highly converged beam on an amorphous specimen region reveals lens-aberration signatures.
Its center and edge always have identical magnification, independent of focus.
Its focus-dependent appearance can reveal coma, astigmatism and three-fold astigmatism; correction can enlarge the usable in-focus region.

questions.explanation:
A 错：课件使用非晶区，而非要求完美单晶衍射。B 对：Ronchigram用于直接观察透镜像差。C 错：课件明确中心放大更高，形状也依赖调焦。D 对：视频示意这些像差，校正后可用聚焦区域扩大，从而容许更大孔径。

重点词：Ronchigram（像差对准图）；amorphous region（非晶区域）；alignment（对准）
逻辑链：会聚束照射非晶区 → 图样显露焦点与像差特征 → 对准后扩大可用聚焦区域。

questions.prompt: Why are multipole elements useful for controlling an electron beam?

options.text: Magnetic fields can exert direction-dependent forces that reshape the beam.
The stigmator is an example of using such forces to correct an oval beam.
They work only by absorbing outer electrons, just as a circular aperture does.
A multipole corrector and a small aperture are interchangeable without changing beam shape or current.

questions.explanation:
A 对：多极磁场的方向性使不同位置的电子受到不同作用，可以重塑束形。B 对：像散校正器是这种思想的实际例子。C 错：多极元件通过磁场和洛伦兹力调轨迹，不是只吸收电子。D 错：挡束与改变聚焦轨迹的机制不同，能利用的束流也不同。

重点词：multipole（多极元件）；Lorentz force（洛伦兹力）；beam shaping（束形调控）
逻辑链：方向性磁场 → 电子轨迹被有选择地改变 → 束形可被校正；这不同于单纯挡束。

questions.prompt: An aberration corrector differs from merely closing the objective aperture because

options.text: A stack of multipole elements reshapes the beam to compensate lens aberrations.
The corrector and ordinary magnetic lens together act effectively like an aspherical lens.
The main effect is to discard every high-angle electron while leaving all optical forces unchanged.
Correction can make a larger numerical aperture useful rather than requiring every outer ray to be blocked.

questions.explanation:
A、B 对：多级多极透镜联合作用补偿像差，获得等效非球面聚焦。C 错：这混淆了校正与单纯挡束。D 对：校正使更多角度成分也能充分聚焦，因而可扩大可用NA。

重点词：aberration corrector（像差校正器）；numerical aperture（数值孔径）；aspherical focusing（等效非球面聚焦）
逻辑链：多极元件补偿像差 → 更多高角度电子可正确聚焦 → 更大孔径变得可用。

questions.prompt: At fixed acceleration voltage, spherical-aberration correction lowers the aberration curve in a probe-size graph. Which predictions are reasonable?

options.text: The diffraction contribution must disappear because the electrons are no longer waves.
The optimum aperture must stay at the same value because the wavelength has not changed.
A larger useful aperture can form a smaller probe while passing more beam electrons.
Improved probe localization and higher usable current can support high-resolution, faster imaging and spectroscopy.

questions.explanation:
A 错：课件标明衍射物理仍与原来相同。B 错：总展宽由衍射和球差共同决定，球差曲线降低会改变最佳折中点，通常移向更大孔径。C、D 对：这解释为什么在波长不变时仍可同时得到更小且更亮的探针。

重点词：probe localization（探针局域性）；useful current（可用束流）；spectroscopy（谱学）
逻辑链：球差贡献减小 → 可采用更大有效孔径 → 探针可同时更小且具有更多电子信号。

questions.prompt: A thin material and supported nanoparticles are imaged with different STEM detectors. Which interpretations are justified?

options.text: A change in layer thickness can change an atomic-resolution image even without introducing a new element.
BF and ADF images of the same nanoparticles can show complementary contrast.
A contrast change between regions proves a different element, even if layer number or detector mode also changes.
Identifying the detector geometry and specimen structure is necessary before treating bright or dark features as a chemical fingerprint.

questions.explanation:
A 对：课件的单层/双层例子说明，结构厚度本身也影响图像，不能把所有亮度差都归因于元素不同。B 对：BF和ADF接收不同散射角的电子，可提供互补图像。C 错：模式与结构也是变量，亮度变化不是元素改变的唯一证据。D 对：应先确认探测器和样品结构，再决定能从对比中推断什么。

重点词：contrast（对比）；layer thickness（层厚）；complementary information（互补信息）
逻辑链：探测模式和层厚改变散射对比 → 图像亮度不只由元素身份决定 → 先排除结构/模式差异，再解释化学差异。

questions.prompt: A STEM experiment saves an EDS or EELS spectrum at every scan point. Which statements about this spectrum-imaging dataset are correct?

options.text: Only a single image intensity for the whole specimen remains after acquisition.
Element-related maps can be extracted from the stored spectra while retaining their scan-position information.
The beam must remain fixed at one point throughout the map.
The dataset is identical to an ordinary ADF intensity image, so energy-resolved detection is unnecessary.

questions.explanation:
A 错：逐点保存的是能谱，不是全图仅一个数。B 对：谱与位置关联使采集后可提取元素分布等信息。C 错：必须扫描才能建立空间对应。D 错：普通ADF强度图不等于逐像素能谱，不能提供同样的元素能量信息。

重点词：spectrum imaging（谱像）；scan position（扫描位置）；elemental map（元素分布图）
逻辑链：每个位置记录能谱 → 保留能量与空间信息 → 可再提取元素或其他谱学分布。

questions.prompt: Which statements correctly connect aberration-corrected STEM with local chemical analysis?

options.text: Structural HAADF images can be combined with EDS maps at a grain boundary.
EELS spectrum imaging can distinguish elemental distributions across a layered structure.
A small probe with higher useful current is valuable for localized spectra, but elemental identification still requires the relevant chemical signal.
An aligned Ronchigram by itself replaces both EDS and EELS for elemental identification.

questions.explanation:
A 对：课件用结构图与晶界EDS元素图联合展示局部结构—化学联系。B 对：逐点EELS谱可提取不同元素通道的空间分布。C 对：小探针增强定位，较高可用束流有助于收集谱学信号；元素身份仍需对应化学信号。D 错：Ronchigram用于电子光学对准，不能代替元素谱。

重点词：chemical signal（化学信号）；grain boundary（晶界）；element-specific mapping（元素特异成像）
逻辑链：小探针定位 + 足够信号 → 逐点EDS/EELS → 将局部化学与结构图联系。

questions.prompt: A narrow-energy electron beam still gives perpendicular focus-dependent streaks and a broad probe at large aperture. Which proposed actions are physically justified?

options.text: Treat the perpendicular streaks as astigmatism and adjust the stigmator.
Assume monochromaticity removes spherical aberration, so a larger aperture is always safe.
If spherical aberration is the large-aperture limitation, apply an appropriate multipole corrector before relying on a larger useful aperture.
Increase only display magnification to remove both physical probe broadening and lens aberrations.

questions.explanation:
A 对：像散是方向相关焦距差异，应调stigmator。B 错：窄能量分布主要减轻色差，不能独自消除球差。C 对：多极球差校正可放宽大孔径限制，之后才可重新选择最佳孔径。D 错：显示放大不改变真实束斑、波长或像差；必须先分清限制来源。

重点词：diagnosis（诊断）；monochromaticity（单色性）；physical resolution（实际分辨能力）
逻辑链：先判断像散、球差或色差 → 使用对应电子光学控制 → 真实细节恢复依赖物理束斑，而非显示缩放。

questions.prompt: Small features develop comet-like tails near the edge of the field. Which actions or interpretations are appropriate?

options.text: Check beam alignment and reduce beam tilt relative to the optical axis.
Treat every such tail as a new elongated particle without checking the electron optics.
Use the alignment information to distinguish an imaging distortion from genuine specimen structure.
Apply a conductive coating as the direct optical correction for axial coma.

questions.explanation:
A 对：课件将这种拖尾与轴向彗差联系，并通过束倾斜对准减轻。B 错：应先排查可随对准改变的成像失真，不能直接当作样品形状。C 对：这正是对准和Ronchigram检查的实用意义。D 错：导电镀层针对充电，不是修正透镜彗差的直接操作。

重点词：comet-like tail（彗星状拖尾）；beam tilt（束倾斜）；image artefact（成像伪影）
逻辑链：图像边缘拖尾 → 考虑轴向彗差并检查束倾斜 → 校正后再判断是否为真实形貌。

questions.prompt: An instrument has spherical-aberration correction, but a broader electron-energy distribution still degrades focus. Which conclusions are justified?

options.text: Correcting spherical aberration does not automatically remove energy-dependent focusing differences.
A narrower energy distribution can reduce the chromatic contribution.
The blur proves that spherical and chromatic aberrations are the same physical effect.
Increasing display magnification is sufficient to restore the missing fine detail.

questions.explanation:
A 对：球差关注近轴/远轴轨迹，色差关注不同能量的聚焦，二者不等同。B 对：能量分布变窄，可减少不同能量的焦点差异。C 错：像差可以并存，不能因都表现为模糊就混为一个机制。D 错：显示放大不会改变真实聚焦和探针展宽。

重点词：chromatic contribution（色差贡献）；energy distribution（能量分布）；spherical correction（球差校正）
逻辑链：能量分布变宽 → 不同能量电子的聚焦位置更分散 → 即使已校正球差，也可能仍需控制色差。
